# FMC Media PC 0.2.11

- Arabic Sources now uses the selected Source browser design: compact provider navigation on the left and one panel for the selected provider's playback servers.
- Select a server's quality, then use the clear Play action at the bottom. Selection stays visible while browsing; filters and provider refreshes cannot play a stale or hidden link.
- Matched/saved work names, version buttons, equivalent-provider choices and alternative title searches remain available in the provider panel. Empty providers are collected below the provider list.
- Reduced the dialog width and repeated information. Title/episode search is expandable; provider status and search progress remain visible.
